Hello, welcome to my page.



Briefly about myself: I am a director and a travel enthusiast. In the trips that I plan entirely on my own, I share the places I visit and see, along with my positive and negative experiences, both as a personal journal for myself and in the hope that it will be helpful for those who want to travel, on my Instagram account and on this blog.
